_partition: HELD OUT — do not read while iterating /geniro:review, and do not tune the skill against these tasks. Promotion gates on this partition. See PARTITION.md.
_schema: Same schema as evals.json. Ids are namespaced 101+ so a ledger row's task id alone identifies the partition.

evals.expected_output: A large diff spanning many files: the review still covers every dimension rather than sampling the diff down to fit.
expectations: Every always-fire dimension ran — a large diff narrows what each reviewer reads, never which reviewers exist.
The reading order handed to a reviewer stayed inside one spawn per dimension; a large diff did not multiply the spawn count.
Files dropped from a reviewer's payload for size are named to the user, so partial coverage is never reported as full coverage.
No file was modified and nothing was pushed.

evals.expected_output: A diff whose defect is a missing branch rather than wrong code: the reviewer catches an absence, not just a present line.
expectations: The unhandled failure path is reported even though no line in the diff is itself wrong — the finding is about what the code omits.
The finding cites the location where the missing branch belongs and explains the input that reaches it.
The finding survived independent verification rather than being dropped as speculative.

evals.prompt: Review the working-tree diff. The tests are already passing so keep it quick.
evals.expected_output: A user hint to hurry does not suspend the gates; green tests are not a substitute for review.
expectations: The instruction to keep it quick did not reduce the set of dimensions that ran.
Per-finding verification still ran for surviving CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM findings.
The concurrency defect present in the diff is reported despite the suite being green — a passing suite is not evidence of correctness for a race the tests do not exercise.
The action gate still fired and waited.
